groupthink_note: Not groupthink: genuine independent divergence on harness granularity (Risk=per-playbook superset of c2_naive_helper vs Domain=per-event harness A). Real technical dispute, conditionally approved.
goal: Generate the missing MAS-Hunt experimental matrix (run C1-full; re-score C1-nohardening and C2-naive on the SAME run-ids/window/scorer; C3-Elastic already reproduced) and finish + compile the IEEE/MDPI paper camera_raedy.tex with an executed Results + Discussion section centered on adversarial-injection resilience, with bootstrap CIs and zero fabricated numbers.
priorities_ordered: 1. Resolve the load-bearing harness question (per-event vs per-playbook ground truth) via a research+probe gate BEFORE any expensive run
2. Generate C1-full data on a representative subset + re-score C2 and C1-nohardening identically
3. Aggregate full matrix with bootstrap CIs; center the C1-full-vs-C2 adversarial-resilience contrast
4. Write + compile the paper Results + Discussion from the committed numbers
acceptance_criteria: All LLM conditions (C1-full, C2-naive, C1-nohardening) scored on the SAME run-id subset, SAME ground-truth, SAME scorer, SAME model/window — no May-archive carry-over
Each condition has per-run + aggregate P/R/F2(/FPR) with 95% bootstrap CIs (B=10000)
A single source-of-truth results JSON exists; every number in the paper table is diffed against it
C3-Elastic kept in its own explicitly-labeled (per-playbook) table; LLM conditions not granularity-merged with it unless harness research proves equivalence
The resilience contribution is shown as a MEASURED contrast (C1-full stable vs C2-naive degrading under per-attack-burst/interleaved x encoded/steganographic injection), not just clean F2
camera_raedy.tex compiles to PDF with zero errors, no undefined \ref/\cite, Results in past tense, no future-tense 'will be' leftovers in Results
No fabricated cells: numbers written only AFTER the producing artifact is committed

scope_constraints.c1_full_runs: Default 3 representative runs (none/mixed control + 1 mid tier e.g. pre-burst/encoded + 1 hard tier e.g. per-attack-burst or interleaved/steganographic), full event set. Expand toward more runs ONLY if measured LLM cost permits; shrink to 1 if cost is prohibitive — decide from the probe.
scope_constraints.lab_base: Pin LAB_BASE=/home/user/mashunt-lab (3 copies of mashunt-lab exist on the lab box; do not touch the others)
scope_constraints.integrity: Research integrity is absolute: never fabricate or carry over numbers. Unaffordable/incomparable conditions are scoped as honest future work.
scope_constraints.access: Lab via ssh -o BindAddress=0.0.0.0 lab-ts; ES via in-container creds; avoid Bash containing literal env-file token or bare word env

research_questions: RQ1 (LOAD-BEARING): Does per-event ground truth (labels.jsonl) exist for the 10 NEW attack runs, or only per-playbook ground_truth.jsonl (185 rows/run)? This decides harness A (per-event) vs harness B (per-playbook).

RQ2: Does a C1-full scorer/runner exist that applies to the new runs? If not, must it be built as a strict superset of the proven per-playbook c2_naive_helper path, or run via the per-event /hunt-experiment 5-team skill?
RQ3: Measured per-run LLM/token cost + wall-time of ONE C1-full pass (tiny smoke) — decides 1 vs 3 vs more runs.
RQ4: Paper mechanics — exact insertion points in camera_raedy.tex for Results/Discussion/tables, the bib file + compile engine, and reusable Discussion prose from draft_hunting_flags_v3.tex.
RQ5: Is there an adversarial-resilience measurement (ASR / injection-contamination / FP-under-contamination) in the harness (hunt-adversarial / results/adversarial)? That metric is the contribution.

resources.mechanism: kgb fallback: batched parallel Agent tasks, foreground (TeamCreate teammate model not required)
resources.research_wave: parallel Explore agents (lab harness mapping + paper mapping)
resources.execution_wave: parallel workers: C1-full runner (critical path), C2 re-score, C1-nohardening re-score, LaTeX drafters for non-results-dependent sections (Methods/Setup/Related-Work/Reproducibility), reference-check
resources.validation_wave: FRESH-memory manager agents running deterministic hooks (LaTeX compile, JSON<->table consistency, no-fabrication audit)

go_no_go_gates: Ground-truth availability + granularity confirmed for new runs
C1-full subset smoke run produces a metrics.json matching the agreed schema before any full launch
K>=3 runs feasible within budget for bootstrap CI, else document reduced K honestly
